ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there are three straight lines intersecting at the same point: one vertical line, and two oblique lines. The sector-shaped region between the two oblique lines on the left side is shaded gray, and let this gray angle be x. The 108° arc marked on the left goes from the vertically upward ray to the lower-left oblique line, including the angle between the vertically upward ray and the upper-left oblique line and the gray angle x. The 124° arc marked on the right goes from the vertically upward ray to the lower-right oblique line. Reasoning: One side of the vertical line on the right side is a straight angle, totaling 180°. The angle outside the 124° arc on the right, between the lower-right oblique line and the vertically downward ray, is 180° - 124° = 56°. This 56° angle and the angle between the upper-left vertically upward ray and the upper-left oblique line are vertical angles, so the upper-left angle is also 56°. The 108° given on the left equals the upper-left angle 56° plus the gray angle x, therefore x = 108° - 56° = 52°.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as three straight lines meeting at one point: a vertical line, an upward-right/downward-left diagonal, and an upward-left/downward-right diagonal. Let the grey angle between the two left-pointing diagonal rays be x. From the image, the 108° arc on the left is the sum of the angle between the upward vertical ray and the upper-left diagonal ray plus x. The 124° arc on the right is the sum of the angle between the upward vertical ray and the upper-right diagonal ray and the angle between the upper-right diagonal ray and the lower-right diagonal ray. Use straight-line and vertical-opposite-angle facts: the angle between the two right diagonal rays is vertically opposite the grey angle, so it is also x; the remaining right-side angle between the lower-right diagonal ray and the downward vertical ray is vertically opposite the top-left angle. Since the right side of the vertical line is a straight angle, that remaining angle is 180° - 124° = 56°. Thus the top-left angle is 56°. The left given angle is 108° = 56° + x, so x = 52°. The grey angle is 52°.
